title: Guided rollback simulator for region-tier routing with cost & SLA preview
creator: Maya R. Patel
description: Build a guided simulation and preview experience inside Console's policy editor that lets customers author region+tier routing policies and validate them against expected cost and SLA impact before saving or rolling out. The feature must support: region selection, tier prioritization (e.g., premium -> standard -> best-effort), explicit fallback model variants (same-arch quantized variants), and a rollback simulator that shows the effect of canary failures and automated fallbacks. Deliver a UX that is opinionated for common patterns but allows advanced JSON policy editing.
acceptance_criteria: Editor exposes region selector, tier order UI, and model-variant override fields
Inline validation surface shows conflicting rules with clear remediation guidance
Preview panel runs simulated traffic (synthetic scenarios) and reports: latency distribution, estimated per-token cost delta, and percent of requests hitting fallbacks
Rollback simulator demonstrates: canary failure, regional outage, and quota exhaustion and shows final routing decisions for each scenario
Saved policies produce machine-readable policy DSL that matches runtime routing behaviour and passes ENG integration tests
UX flows have accessibility labels and the Console telemetry events required for rollout metrics
scope: Design and implement Console UI changes (policy authoring canvas + preview panel) + validation rules + telemetry contract. Provide example presets (region-first, cost-first, latency-first) and one advanced JSON editor mode. Work with eng to surface backend validation API and preview simulator endpoints.
out_of_scope: Implementing the runtime routing changes (ENG will own enforcement and fallback execution)
On-prem installer changes for Private deployments
Billing changes to actually charge customers based on previewed cost (preview is advisory only)

rollout_plan: Phase 1 (alpha): internal customers + feature flag for 2 enterprise accounts. Collect preview vs actual delta telemetry for 2 weeks. Phase 2 (beta): enable to broader set with opt-in banner and usage guide. Phase 3 (GA): enabled by default with docs and in-app tutorials.
risks: Preview cost estimates may diverge from actual billing due to future kernel/quant changes
Complex policies could produce validation false-positives; need a clear escape hatch (force save with disclaimer)
Simulator may leak sensitive topology if sample traces are not sanitized — ensure PII scrubbers are applied
sample_validation_rules: Disallow circular fallbacks where model A -> B -> A
Warn if tier priority would route >50% of baseline traffic to best-effort under normal load
Error when region selector is empty or references unsupported regions for the customer's subscription
Warn when fallback variant has incompatible architecture (e.g., llama -> opt)
preview_scenarios: Baseline: steady-state traffic distribution from customer's historical sample
Canary failure: simulate canary region dropping 100% capacity and show automatic region-tier shifts
Latency spike: simulate 500ms latency increase in premium tier and show option to reroute to standard
Quota exhaustion: simulate dedicated pool hitting throughput cap and verify fallback to hosted model variant
